title: Rav Acha the Galilean
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Avodah Zarah 3b, according to Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim, saying to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: “From the day the Temple was destroyed there is no laughter before the Holy One, blessed be He.” The text Hyman uses reads Rav Acha without further designation, and Yalkut, Isaiah, remez 451 reads Rav Acha of Migdal.

notes.text: The consulted Avodah Zarah 3b has Acha. The Ein Yaakov, Dikdukei Soferim and Yalkut readings are reported by Hyman.
